name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 4: SOK-stugan - Rya åsar
description: SOK-stugan to Rya åsar. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Kvarnbäcken and other natural water: Historic/nature context only. Carry water and treat natural water if used.
notes: Naturkartan says Sjuhäradsleden as a whole is not fully quality-assured by Västkuststiftelsen, and STF warns some reroutes may not be updated. Västsverige says stages 3-7 are quality-assured.

Naturkartan GPX starts section 4 at the section-continuity point [57.732249, 12.798726], while Borås/OSM place SOK-stugan clubhouse/access around [57.732080, 12.795553] to [57.732233, 12.795353], about 189-200 m west.
Naturkartan GPX ends section 4 at [57.746806, 12.920277] and joins Etapp 5, while Borås/OSM access/end coordinates near Björbobacken/Rya åsar are about 186 m away.
OSM relation 4176439 is continuous and matches the interior line well but is stored reverse relative to its own from/to tags.
A 2025 blog reports SOK-stugan unlocked with toilets, shower, water refill and charging, but official public hiker access to those clubhouse utilities was not confirmed.
Länsstyrelsen/Borås reserve context mentions water near Ramshulan, but section research did not confirm potability or reliability.

facilities.name: Källebergs stugan / Källeberg raststuga
facilities.description: Rest hut built in period style at Källeberg/Källartomten. Borås says it can be used to rest or overnight and cannot be booked. OSM suggests 2-3 sleeping places. No current toilet, potable water or waste source found. Confirm current condition/overnight etiquette before publication if possible.

facilities.name: Eldplats vid Källeberg
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill at the Källeberg rest hut. Usability depends on current fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Enebacken / Källeberg fossil farmland
facilities.description: Protected fossil farmland/clearance-cairn landscape around Källeberg/Källartomten. Useful context POI, not a utility facility. If archaeology area extents are needed, verify with official cultural heritage datasets rather than the point coordinate.

facilities.name: Kvarnrester i Kvarnbäcken
facilities.description: Historic mill remains at Kvarnbäcken, about 100 m from the trail. Treat the brook/waterfall as context, not as drinking water. Not a water source.

facilities.name: Hestrastugan grillplats
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace behind Hestrastugan, with local parking. Clubhouse opening hours should not be treated as public hiker toilet/water/food service. Verify whether this should be associated with the trail or kept as nearby access/rest metadata.

facilities.name: Rya åsar Högplatån / Björbobacken picnic cluster
facilities.description: Rya åsar entrance-area picnic/grill/shelter cluster around Högplatån/Björbobacken/Sjötorp. Useful end-stage rest/access facility cluster. Cluster may combine several nearby named facilities; verify exact intended object names before normalization.

facilities.name: Rya åsar / Björbobacken main entrance
facilities.description: Main Rya åsar reserve access cluster at Björbobacken, with parking, information board, accessible toilet, waste basket and paid electric motorhome spaces. This is the practical access cluster near the official end, not the Naturkartan continuity endpoint. Do not model motorhome parking as hiking facility except as access metadata.
